$comment: Time-boxed npm-audit exceptions. Each entry is a GHSA the CI audit gate will tolerate at high/critical severity UNTIL `expires`. After that date the allowlist is ignored and the gate fails again, forcing resolution. Consumed by scripts/audit-allowlist.mjs (Security workflow). This is NOT a place to silence real exposure: every entry must be triaged non-reachable in this app and tracked to a fix. 2026-09-09 (Captain-authorized): six high/critical advisories were blocking the required Security Summary gate on every PR, and their patched releases sit newer than the .npmrc min-release-age cooldown — the exact case this file exists for. Two are critical Astro issues; accepted as temporary risk only, tracked in #2711, expiring 2026-09-23.

allow.GHSA-26w7-cxv4-gfx2: Astro: RCE via AVIF image optimization (critical). Temp exception, cooldown-blocked fix, tracked #2711.
allow.GHSA-376h-93r7-7g6f: Astro: authorization bypass from missing base path-segment boundary check (critical). Temp exception, tracked #2711.
allow.GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh: js-yaml: maxTotalMergeKeys does not limit CPU use for empty merge sources (high). Temp exception, tracked #2711.
allow.GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c: sharp: libheif vulnerabilities GHSA-g89c-p67h-r497 / GHSA-2jg2-4ch7-h545 (high). Temp exception, tracked #2711.
allow.GHSA-w27v-7q3p-w38r: SVGO: removeScripts allows executable links through namespace and control-character bypasses (high). Temp exception, tracked #2711.
allow.GHSA-4vpr-x523-8j87: SVGO: removeScripts incompletely sanitizes executable HTML in SVG foreignObject elements (high). Temp exception, tracked #2711.
